import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Analysis of Flower Measurements by Species', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Color palette for species
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#95E1D3'}

# 1. Pairwise scatter plot of petal dimensions (top-left)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(data['petal_length'], data['petal_width'], 
               label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5,
               color=colors[species])
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Pairwise scatter plot of sepal dimensions (top-right)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(data['sepal_length'], data['sepal_width'], 
               label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5,
               color=colors[species])
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Box plots for all measurements (bottom-left)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df_melted = df.melt(id_vars='species', var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value')
sns.boxplot(data=df_melted, x='Measurement', y='Value', hue='species', 
            ax=ax3, palette=colors, linewidth=1.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Measurement (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Distribution of All Measurements by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'], 
                     fontsize=9)
ax3.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9, loc='upper left')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Violin plot showing petal length distribution (bottom-right)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
parts = ax4.violinplot([df[df['species'] == species]['petal_length'].values 
                        for species in ['setosa', 'versicolor', 'virginica']], 
                       positions=[1, 2, 3], widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)

# Color the violin plots
for i, pc in enumerate(parts['bodies']):
    species = ['setosa', 'versicolor', 'virginica'][i]
    pc.set_facecolor(colors[species])
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
    pc.set_edgecolor('black')
    pc.set_linewidth(1.5)

ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xticks([1, 2, 3])
ax4.set_xticklabels(['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica'], fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
